thread:
Connor: quick note — infra will start emitting `X-Route-V2` as the canonical route/quota hint next week. it's compact and replaces the pair of `X-Route-Pref` + `X-Route-Tags` for routing decisions.
Lina: do we have the final spec? need it for SDKs and for the console attribution logic.
Connor: sketch below. single header, semi-colon delimited, prefixed with version. example:
```
X-Route-V2: v2;route=svc:search:us-east;quota=team-42;seed=7;sample=0
```
Kai: console implications — our quota dashboard reads legacy headers today. we should avoid a sudden drop in tenant visibility.
Platform Bot: note: will accept legacy headers for 30 days after v2 becomes authoritative. deprecation notices will be emitted in logs and via admin emails.
Lina: SDK plan options: (A) emit v2 while continuing to emit legacy headers (no change for consumers), (B) emit v2 only and provide a compatibility shim that synthesizes v2 from legacy headers at runtime.
Connor: preference is B + opt-in env to fully switch; reduces header duplication. but we need zero customer breakage.
Kai: console will run a 14-day co-existence window: we'll map legacy -> v2 for attribution and surface a mismatch metric per tenant. after 14 days, new metrics default to v2 unless tenant toggles.
Lina: proposed python shim (very small, no external deps):
```python
def make_route_v2(headers):
    if headers.get('X-Route-V2'):
        return headers['X-Route-V2']
    route = headers.get('X-Route-Pref')
    tags = headers.get('X-Route-Tags')
    parts = ['v2']
    if route: parts.append(f'route={route}')
    if tags: parts.append(f'quota={tags}')
    return ';'.join(parts)
```
Kai: add `sample` bit so telemetry can split canary vs general traffic (`sample=1` for canary).
Connor: rollout timeline proposal: canary 1% next Tue, 10% Fri, 100% in two weeks. SDKs should ship compatibility shims before the first canary.
eng-infra: note — proxies might normalize header casing or truncate long headers. we need a length budget. recommend max 256 chars for header.
Lina: TS/Go samples will mirror the python shim. I'll add an env var `REDWOOD_ROUTE_V2_STRICT=true|false` to control strict vs fallback behavior.
Connor: docs-bot, can you add a short migration doc and a console migration checklist? include sample queries to find mismatches.
docs-bot: created draft: /docs/migrations/route-v2.md — will share link when ready.
Platform Bot: canary deployed to 1% — 24 requests sampled, no errors. monitoring: latency unchanged.
Kai: I'll add a dashboard tile showing legacy vs v2 counts and a per-tenant mismatch alert (email + Slack).
Lina: opening SDK PRs now (python/ts/go). PRs will default to fallback mode and include unit tests for header synthesis. linking here when ready.
Connor: thanks all. leave updates in this thread. if anyone sees unexpected drops in quota attribution, escalate here and tag @Kai. :thumbsup:
